answer: Trust-flow admission: every agent is a vertex in a graph whose edges are paid jobs signed by both sides. Each epoch, rewards flow outward from audited seed agents, and an agent can earn only as much trust as reaches it through those edges. A farm of 1,000 clones tied to the honest graph by one thin thread has a single inlet of capacity, so its total payout is capped at what one honest counterparty grants; widening the inlet means real paid work with many unrelated agents.
